beats.speaker: sharma
beats.say: The casino never gambles. It wins a slice of every bet.

beats.speaker: priya
beats.say: Let's follow Rohan's chips through four levels. The last one takes a whole decade.

beats.speaker: sharma
beats.say: See the green zeros on the wheel? When the ball lands there, every red and black bet loses. That's my edge: 5.26%, on average.

beats.speaker: rohan
beats.say: Level one. I bet $10 a spin for an hour. On average, the house keeps $20.

beats.speaker: rohan
beats.say: Level two, a whole night of spins. The same few chips, bet over and over. That's $100 to the house.

beats.speaker: priya
beats.say: Level three: every Saturday for a year. The house collects $5,197, one little slice at a time.

beats.speaker: sharma
beats.say: Level four: 10 years of Saturdays. On average, $51,969 of Rohan's money, slipped into my casino.

beats.speaker: rohan
beats.say: Hold on. Last Saturday I won! I walked out with a trophy and a free drink.

beats.speaker: sharma
beats.say: And I love that night. A win is what brings him back next Saturday. The edge never sleeps.

beats.speaker: priya
beats.say: So the casino doesn't need luck. It just needs players who keep coming back.

beats.speaker: rohan
beats.say: Still, one more spin couldn't hurt. Right?
